key_insight: Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN) reduces catastrophic forgetting by adding novelty-gated capacity rather than repeatedly overwriting shared parameters.
engineering_relevance: KFN could support sequential learning in engineering workflows, but the abstract does not validate constitutive modeling or solid-mechanics applications.
method: Learn each incoming task in an isolated 2.8M-parameter specialist network.
Fuse new knowledge into the global model using dedicated channels allocated by a quantitative novelty score.
Protect consolidated knowledge through channel separation and phased gradient unfreezing.
evidence_signal: On Split CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT, KFN reports class-incremental retention of 72.7% and 42.5%, versus best-baseline values of 29.6% and 0.94%, while using 28.1M parameters versus 112.0M for backbone duplication over ten tasks.
watch_item: Capacity still grows with task count, and scalability beyond the reported ten-task setting remains unestablished.
paper_title: Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning
